'''Ethel Rethor''' {{coords|41|31|Desolace}} is a [[night elven]] ruin in the far northwest of [[Desolace]].  Most of the ruins are located under-water with the exception of a lone tower with a small bridge leading to an un-openable entrance.  In the shadow of the tower, to the immediate north, there is a representative of the [[Argent Dawn]] named [[Azore Aldamort]].

As with many other coastal elven ruins this one is also inhabited by [[naga]], though they seem to avoid the tower entirely.
